versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the HashCats Amazon Intelligence skill.
- Enables agents to perform Amazon product search, filtering, ranking, detailed extraction, and one-shot "best products" recommendations via the x402 pay-per-call API.
- No API keys required; payments handled automatically using USDC (x402 flow).
- Provides structured JSON outputs for all endpoints, optimized for agent reasoning and composability.
- Supports endpoints: /search, /filter, /rank, /product-details, and /best.
- Comprehensive usage instructions, pricing, and documentation links included.
